name: Go

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Test
        run: go test -v ./...
      - name: Race
        run: go test -v -race ./...

package main

import (
	"fmt"
)

// panicf panics with formatted error message.
func panicf(format string, values ...any) {
	panic(fmt.Sprintf(format, values...))
}
